actions.name: lunch
actions.description: What's for school lunch on a day, from each kid's school menu ("what's for lunch tomorrow?", "what's Maya having on Tuesday?"). Say what it answers, as it is.

date.description: The day they mean, as YYYY-MM-DD. Leave out for the next school day.

who.description: The kid, by name, if they said one

actions.name: week
actions.description: The school lunches for a whole week, a day at a time ("what are the lunches this week?"). Say what it answers.

who.description: The kid, by name, if they said one

next.description: Next week instead of this one
